lanes.name: ticket-dashboard
lanes.purpose: grouped diagnostic context delivered to Telegram

lanes.name: page
excludes: individual low-level component failure without customer-impact gate

lanes.name: page-recovery
events: recovery of a page-lane Flux object
lanes.purpose: recovery notification; receiver grouping prevents duplicate incident creation

policy.repeat_interval: 2h page, 24h diagnostic; backup and capacity consolidated at 24h
inhibition: page alerts inhibit matching diagnostic alerts
deployment diagnostic events never suppress page alerts
approved maintenance suppression remains a future policy input
policy.recovery: Actionable page Prometheus alerts retain resolved delivery through telegram-page; diagnostic/default Prometheus alerts suppress resolved delivery; Flux recovery events use the page-recovery Alert lane and telegram-page
policy.low_level_gate: no page from a single HelmRelease, Pod, PVC, or controller error unless an approved SLO, routing, storage, or parent-Kustomization impact gate is also true

verification.diagnostic_event: synthetic critical Alertmanager event submitted through the private service API

failure_observability.independent_signal_required: external monitor of the native cluster and a periodic diagnostic delivery; tracked separately in platform issue 14
